clusters.name: Your sister Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, within the following year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents' distance by November, your stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah's shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother not returning to her job by September. Each shift sits near another's across these months.
